name: Metric & Benchmark Callout
description: High-impact metric and benchmark callout card with geometric hero number, delta badge, headline takeaway, supporting context bullets, and source attribution.
distillationHint: Choose the single most striking quantitative figure (e.g. '43.6 fps', '10.4x', '99.98%') plus a short delta badge ('+310% faster'), a 1-sentence headline explaining what the number means, and up to 3 supporting bullet points.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow Label
eyebrow.description: Short uppercase context label above the metric.

deltaBadge.label: Delta / Comparison Pill
deltaBadge.description: Short comparison badge next to the metric (e.g., '150 FRAMES @ 1080P').

headline.label: Headline Takeaway
headline.description: Clear 1-sentence explanation of what the metric proves.

highlights.label: Supporting Highlights
highlights.description: 1 to 3 concise supporting facts or benchmark parameters.

source.label: Source / Footnote
